decision_timing: Before circle8 inward10 coarse completion and before any circle medium result
objective: Maximum gross vertical lift; smaller footprint is secondary for unresolved close results
scope: One bounded circle refinement cycle, without another circle spacing/angle grid
medium_baseline: Promote the completed stable circle8 flat reference now

coarse_to_medium.candidates: Best stable flat circle and strongest tested own-spacing tilted circle
coarse_to_medium.widen_if: Observed matched resolution, late-window or initialization variation is larger
coarse_to_medium.meaning: Adaptive triage only; not a confidence interval or numerical-error bound

medium_to_fine.partner_purpose: Its same-spacing flat or tilted reference when required for a paired tilt comparison
medium_to_fine.retain_if: Medium gap is within about 2 percent of the comparable square frontier, or within a larger observed refinement/late-window/initialization envelope; unresolved medium drift also prevents confident rejection
medium_to_fine.release_timing: After circle medium and pending tilt results identify the smallest useful fine comparison
medium_to_fine.meaning: Screening policy only; remaining uncertainty must be reported

coarse_context.warning: These frontier gaps vary layout, spacing and tilt; they are not isolated planform or tilt effects

reporting: Best tested region within the stated actuator model; no continuous or global optimum claim
